description: Everything OceanAlt can say about an address, in one Ed25519-signed bundle you can verify offline: screening verdict + evidence + freshness, self-built profile signals, one-hop relations to listed addresses, fulfillment receipt stats. OceanAlt is a witness, not a plaintiff: no conclusions, no attribution of persons, every item carries its source and coverage date. Everything inside is already public; there is no user data and no privileged channel — anyone may request one. Free, 10 per minute.
